answer_1.quote: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning significantly enhances the performance of large language models (LLMs) on complex tasks by decomposing questions into intermediate steps and reasoning sequentially.
answer_1.outputs: Chain-of-Thought reasoning traces and final answers

answer_2.quote: We evaluate MACC using four key metrics to comprehensively assess reasoning performance and efficiency: accuracy (percentage of correctly answered questions), average CoT token count (to quantify reasoning verbosity), inference latency, and Token Efficiency.
